short_description: Brightwave — a consumer brand's campaign-replication-and-budget rescue. Attribution landing too late left a fifth of paid spend in underperforming campaigns while a cluster of winners quietly outperformed on a specific channel-and-creative combination. A marketing app reads governed campaign + spend data at low latency, a recommendation ranks the move (replicate a winner / reallocate budget / pause) per underperformer, and a CMO approves mid-quarter — turning governed lakehouse data into a marketing action, on-brand, with the assistant's content-generation AI spend capped and observable.
